annotations.title: Screen a species list against the registers

description: Which species on a list are protected or at risk? A species list in one call: up to 500 names, each answered by find_designations itself, for one place or everywhere: its designations with their cites and the registers searched that are `silent` on it with what each one's silence means, or its own coded refusal (`designations.none_held` = no register searched names it; `species.ambiguous` with candidates). A register's instrument, edition, source URL and sha256 are sent once, in `registers`. `summary` counts the names listed, listed only under a population or subspecies, watch-listed, named but not listed, named by no register, ambiguous and refused, and how many names each register lists. A name no register names is a statement about these registers, never that the species is unprotected.

place.description: ISO 3166 code of where the species are: a country (US, CA, GB, FR) or a state or province (US-CA, CA-ON, GB-SCT). Omit to search every register.

species.description: The names, as the list prints them: scientific names (authorship allowed) or common names exactly as a register prints them.

name: screen_species
title: Screen a species list against the registers
